# California Revenue and Taxation Code Section 17041 - Tax Brackets and Indexing

## Tax Rate Table (Subdivision a(1))

The statute imposes taxes on resident taxable income using these initial brackets:

"Not over $3,650 / 1% of the taxable income / Over $3,650 but not over $8,650 / $36.50 plus 2% of the excess"

## Indexing Methodology (Subdivision h)

The Franchise Tax Board adjusts tax brackets annually using a specific inflation measure and rounding rule:

"Multiply the preceding taxable year income tax brackets by the inflation adjustment factor...and round off the resulting products to the nearest one dollar ($1)."

The inflation adjustment derives from: "the percentage change in the California Consumer Price Index for all items from June of the prior calendar year to June of the current calendar year"

This annual adjustment mechanism ensures the tax brackets keep pace with inflation using the state's consumer price index as the measurement standard.
